spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_crypto
spec.hypothesis: Short-window taker buy/sell volume imbalance (aggressor flow) predicts 5-15min directional continuation in the most liquid crypto pairs, large enough to clear T1 fees+spread.
spec.power_argument: 1-min bars, BTCUSD+ETHUSD, signal checked every 5min during full 24h crypto session over a 30-day window yields an estimated 2000+ candidate triggers before entry_per_day_cap binds, comfortably clearing the >=300 trade floor. Assuming return dispersion in line with sprint32/34 net-return sd (~40bps), n=300 gives power>=0.8 at alpha=0.05 to detect a minimum edge of 6bps net of ~2bps T1 taker cost.
